cells.gaps: No source found names a body set up or named to carry out the strategy: a council, office, agency, committee or ministry unit. The Reporter and the UN resident coordinator still called the AI policy a draft in August 2026.
cells.note: The ICT minister said the government approved the National AI Policy in the second half of 2025, and it was published on 17 August 2026, which meets stage 3; no body is named to carry it out, so not stage 4.
